coding.title: Pair Sum
coding.statement: Given an array of integers and a target value, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target. Assume exactly one solution exists.

coding.title: Reverse Words
coding.statement: Given a sentence, return it with the order of the words reversed, preserving single spaces between words.

coding.title: Max Subarray Sum
coding.statement: Given an array of integers, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum and return that sum.

aptitude.question: A train travels 60 km in 45 minutes. At the same speed, how far does it travel in 2 hours?
A shirt is marked at $80 and sold at a 25% discount. What is the sale price?
If 8 workers can build a wall in 15 days, how many days will 12 workers take, assuming the same work rate per worker?
A bag has 3 red balls and 5 blue balls. What is the probability of drawing a red ball at random?
What is the next number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?

logic.question: Estimate how many piano tuners work in a city of 1 million people. Walk through your reasoning.
logic.judging_criteria: Reward a structured breakdown (households -> pianos per household -> tuning frequency -> tuner capacity) over a bare guessed number.

logic.question: Estimate how many gas stations there are in your country. Walk through your reasoning.
logic.judging_criteria: Reward a structured breakdown (population -> cars per capita -> avg fill-ups per station -> demand) over a bare guessed number.

logic.question: You have two ropes, each of which takes exactly 60 minutes to burn, but they burn unevenly. How do you measure exactly 45 minutes using only these two ropes and a lighter?
logic.judging_criteria: Reward correctly identifying that lighting a rope at both ends halves its burn time, and combining that with the second rope.
